acceptance: The clean HWA3A baseline is genesis: tests add twelve exact nodes first and all twelve collect and fail solely because the new loader API is absent before any source write.

The only public additions are frozen slots CommitAuthoritySnapshot(capability, evidence, capability_status) and HeadlessWriteAgentStateStore.load_commit_authority(scope, *, claim_id, fence, capability_id, evidence_ref).
capability_status is exactly Literal['issued','reserved','consumed']; caller supplies no stage, status, owner, digest, path, checked_at or authorization boolean.

One explicit BEGIN snapshot completes all independent request-identity probes across hwa_claims, hwa_controls, hwa_capabilities and hwa_evidence before any absence, stale, mismatch or unblocked result.

Every selected persisted field has a fixed projection, non-colliding typeof alias, exact SQLite storage class and exact Python fetched type before semantic use; no persisted-value coercion establishes authority.
The loader internally requires project_commit stage, capability.input_digest equal to evidence.diff_digest, exact scope/claim/fence/control/expiry bindings and returns only detached typed values.
Fresh bounded errors have cause and context None, raw SQLite/JSON/path data never escapes, ordinary Exception normalizes, and KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit propagate.
The twelve exact tests, full state and dependency corridors, static checks, three central validators, independent hostile QA and Deep-Sol pass on one frozen two-blob candidate.
Only src/headless_write_agent_state.py and tests/test_headless_write_agent_state.py may change under a later separately registered claim; this packet grants no writer or live authority.

threat_model: The accepted HWA3A baseline has no typed loader. V4 was impossible because it claimed that loader and snapshot already existed while forbidding their addition. V5 explicitly authorizes exactly one frozen snapshot type and one state-store loader, then closes the full SQLite storage-class, same-byte-BLOB identity, snapshot and fresh-error boundary without trusting caller-supplied authority.
